# Controlled block binding, guards, rescue, forwarding and numbered parameters.
def collect(*args)
  args.map { |x| yield x }
end

def forward(...)
  collect(...)
end

def guarded(ready)
  if ready
    :yes
  else
    :no
  end
end

puts [values, guarded(true), guarded(false), [3,1].sort_by { |x| x }, ["one","two"], [:one,:two]].inspect

puts (1 rescue nil).inspect
